summary: chore(settings): remove the pairing POC pages
description:
Because:
- The pairing POC pages are throwaway test pages.
- FxA no longer needs them.

This commit:
- Deletes PocDeepLink, PocPairInit (with its test) and PocPairStart.
- Removes their lazy imports and routes from the App component.
- Removes the three poc_* paths from content-server-routes.js.
- Removes the pocPairingRoutes group from react-app/index.js.

Closes FXA-14769
